newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end lower as blue chips lose.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end lower as blue chips lose.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed slightly lower as some blue chips in engineering and food sectors fell amid selling pressure, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all -share price index lost 1.99 points or 0.2 percent to 954.08 on turnover of 36.4 million taka. Losers led gainers by 71 to 60 with five unchanged.

"Market sentiment remained weak as the share prices continued to fall for a fourth straight session," said one broker. Singer Bangladesh dropped 21 taka to 4,995, Apex Foods shed 29 to 1,479 and Square Pharma rose 15 to 848.
